payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet

decision.question: Does the edited image show a recognizable frog that was not present in the source image?
decision.criteria: Pass if a recognizable frog is visible in the edited image and no frog is visible in the source image. Fail if no recognizable frog is visible in the edited image, or if the apparent frog was already present in the source. Unknown only if the images do not provide enough visual evidence to judge frog identity or source presence.
decision.source_quote: Put a frog in the toilet
decision.endpoint: A recognizable frog is added to the image as part of putting a frog in the toilet.
decision.necessity: A frog must be added to fulfill the requested change; comparing source and edited images distinguishes an added frog from one already present. This is a necessary aspect of the requested endpoint, not a requirement to limit the number of frogs.
